title: MicroClimateSnapshot
description: Deterministic, derived, read-only local environmental conditions snapshot at a specific coordinate and tick.

simulation_tick.description: Simulation world clock tick at time of calculation

primary_habitat_id.description: Canonical habitat ID resolved at this coordinate

temperature.description: Derived local temperature in Celsius (macro + habitat + shelter delta)

humidity.description: Derived local relative humidity clamped to [0.0, 1.0]

is_sheltered.description: Whether the coordinate / organism is currently inside a valid shelter

shelter_id.description: ID of the enclosing shelter if sheltered, otherwise null
